business_summary: Anhui Zhongfu Yuanchuang Technology Group Co., Ltd. engages in the environmental management business in China. The company is involved in municipal sewage, industrial wastewater treatment, black and odorous water, wetland treatment, other water environment treatment, biotechnology, and waste incineration power generation businesses. It offers urban and rural waste resource treatment; hazardous waste disposal; sludge and food waste treatment; landfill leachate treatment; and photovoltaic power generation system services, as well as engages in the construction, operation, and maintenance of sewage pipe networks. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Hefei, China.
